the male lower urinary tract symptoms and dysfunction terminology is updated and expanded to include male specific symptoms and dysfunction.
a new term for a male specific condition of urinary urgency, with or without urgency incontinence, has been introduced.

the study of the male lower urinary tract, and its associated pelvic floor and genital structures.
the development and application of new methods for the investigation of the lower urinary system and the development of new treatment methods for patients with incontinence.
the development of a new classification of male lower urinary tract symptoms and dysfunction.

the terminology of male LUTS is complex and needs to be updated to reflect the current clinical practice.
the terminology for male symptoms and dysfunction is not yet fully established, and the terminology used in clinical practice is often not in line with that used by the ICS.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the terminology of the lower tract and pelvic floor in males is now updated, and the terminology is now male specific.

the ICS Terminology for the male lower urinary tract is in a state of transition.
